sources.title: Beqa
sources.excerpt: Beqa is an island in Fiji, an outlier to the main island of Viti Levu, 10 kilometres to the south. The island has a land area of 36.3 square kilometres and reaches a maximum elevation of 440 metres. Beqa has 9 villages divided between 2 tikinas (districts): Sawau and Raviravi. To the west is the island of Yanuca.
